Anda Bhurji 
high protein | lazy girl breakfast | 15 minute recipe

Nutrition: 
C: 10 | F: 15 | P: 18
Calories: 259 per serve ( without bread ) 
Serves 2

Ingredients
5 eggs + 1 tbsp milk 
1 tsp oil / butter
1 tsp ginger garlic paste, optional
1/2 onion, finely chopped
1 - 2 green chillies, finely chopped ( adjust as per spice level ) 
1 tomato, finely chopped
spices: red chilli powder + coriander powder + haldi + garam masala + salt 
coriander 

Pro tip: always switch off the heat when the Bhurji is almost done, the latent heat will cook the eggs the remaining bit without over cooking them :)
